scope: Six-period runs of the oscillating-sphere benchmark of docs/VALIDATION.md with the source of commit 046b6f5 (the changes after 0.1.0rc2): full reruns of the archived D32 and D40 cases, and the same benchmark at D16, D32 and D40 with the optional floor of the CG stopping test (solver.cg_reference_speed = 0.02, the peak body speed). Runs of 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-22.

machine.note: one workstation, single runs; the machine was in other use during parts of the multi-day runs

work_directory: local work directory of the author (not distributed); run labels below are relative to it
definitions: As in docs/VALIDATION.md and tools/check_pressure_validation.py: runtime body force fitted by a cos + b sin + c over the last two periods, harmonic-vector error against the unsteady-Stokes force; surface pressure post-processed from the field snapshots at 5T, 5.25T, 5.5T, 5.75T and 6T, pressure zero from the exterior shell 4h-6h, relative area/time L2 error over the four distinct phases. 'two_sided' is the two-sided correction (outer side); 'sphere_exterior' the default path. Stepping seconds are the sums of the per-step times in history.csv (pauses between the legs of an interrupted run are not counted; mesh construction and operator assembly are not included).

d32.case: cases/D32.json of checks/pressure-validation-20260925.zip, run from t = 0 with the default factored operator

pyib_validate.output: VALID: case=D32_N560_inner4 backend=cuda/cupy precision=float64 step=3360 history_rows=675 coverage=full_field force_balance_max=3.781227e-16 atol=1.000000e-09

d32.run_note: three legs (paused once by hand, interrupted once by a restart of the computer; resumed from checkpoints at steps 560 and 1680); the workstation was in other use during the run and some stretches ran at about half the usual rate

d40.case: cases/D40.json of checks/pressure-validation-20260925.zip, run from t = 0 with the default factored operator

pyib_validate.output: VALID: case=D40_N700_inner4 backend=cuda/cupy precision=float64 step=4200 history_rows=843 coverage=full_field force_balance_max=1.743049e-15 atol=1.000000e-09

d40.run_note: interrupted once at step 1155 by a restart of the computer and resumed from the checkpoint at step 700. The case does not fit the 8 GB card with the default CuPy memory pool; these runs used a launcher-side allocator (capped pool with fallback to direct allocations) that is not part of PyIB. A card with more memory needs no such launcher.

cg_floor_six_periods.setting: solver.cg_reference_speed = 0.02; everything else as in the run without the floor (cg_check_interval = 20, four inner iterations, factored operator, CUDA, float64)
